MODEL_FEEDBACK_JSON:
{
  "positive_alignment_reasons": [
    "The powered USB hub fits my history of adding computer connections and gives my USB accessories a practical place to connect, though ten ports may be more than I need.",
    "Ethernet cables relate to my recent USB Ethernet adapter, and wired earbuds with a microphone relate to my earlier headset, even though neither gives me a clear reason to buy now."
  ],
  "negative_misalignment_reasons": [
    "The smart speaker and streaming devices do not help with the computer connectivity needs reflected in my recent purchases.",
    "A twenty-four-port switch and six one-foot cables assume a larger or more specific networking setup than my history supports.",
    "The memory card and gaming surface lack a concrete use for me right now, while a portable speaker serves a different purpose from my earlier headset."
  ],
  "overgeneralized_signals": [
    "Buying computer accessories seems to have been treated as interest in electronics generally, including entertainment devices.",
    "My Ethernet adapter purchase seems to have been taken as a need for extensive networking equipment, and my headset purchase as interest in audio products broadly."
  ],
  "missing_or_underweighted_signals": [
    "My purchases are occasional and tied to specific functions; a related item still needs to solve a current problem before I would choose it.",
    "Connection compatibility, cable length, and the number of ports or cables matter more to me than simply being another connectivity accessory.",
    "My older headset purchase does not establish that I need a replacement now, and I would need to confirm jack compatibility before choosing earbuds."
  ],
  "summary_diagnosis": "The recommendations partly recognize my practical connectivity interests but stretch them into broader electronics interests and equipment needs I have not shown."
}
